values.cost: the standard game (Turbo Mode off) of update 188329, save 68.9, before civ bonuses
values.time: seconds, the standard game (Turbo Mode off) of update 188329, save 68.9. Turbo games' own unit records hold other times (villagers 62 s, castles 500 s) and, in 68.9, cheaper ships; saves 67.2 and 68 differ for 22 to 29 units
values.size: tiles, the standard game; prefer the game's own records (building-sizes.js): farms are 1x1 or 2x2 in some games, and a Poles player's mill is a 3x3 Folwark
